_comment: Hand-authored overlay: per-edge independent_corroboration_state and its sources. The co-listing MATCH itself is computed deterministically by tools/build-cf-overlap.mjs from cf_portfolio_universe.txt x chunk1/companies.jsonl. This file records only the OUT-OF-BAND corroboration gathered by live search on 2026-07-14, keyed by chunk1 company_id. Anything not listed here defaults to independent_corroboration_state='cf_listing_only'.

_states.corroborated: An independent source (press, or CF's own dedicated /startup page) confirms the CF<->company relationship AND the company identity, beyond mere presence of a slug on the portfolio index.
_states.cf_listing_only: The only evidence is the slug on CF's public portfolio index page (RCF01). No independent second source was pulled this pass. Presence on the index is NOT evidence of CF equity.

icon.identity_confirmed: Austin-based construction 3D-printing company; DoD contracts since 2019, USMC expeditionary-construction partnership 2020 — matches NatSec100 defense-relevance.
icon.note: Highest homonym risk of the set (generic word 'icon'); disambiguation was REQUIRED and is now resolved to the construction-tech ICON.

saronic.identity_confirmed: Defense-tech; designs/manufactures Autonomous Surface Vessels (ASVs). CF publicly represents Saronic as a portfolio company.

firefly_aerospace.identity_confirmed: Space-and-defense launch company; listed on Nasdaq (FLY) Aug 2025. CF publicly represents Firefly as a portfolio company.

venus_aerospace.identity_confirmed: Hypersonics developer; CF publicly represents Venus Aerospace as a portfolio company.
